plan.name: Load dashboard acceptance sources by full proposal hash
plan.summary: Complete #715 in one plumbing pull request: keep each waiting legacy or native plan's summary, writable and trusted files, assertions, full test identities and execution metadata in the lightweight state, replace inline acceptance bodies with plan.sourceHash (the full sha256: hash) and plan.sourceURL (/api/plan-sources/<64 lowercase hex digits>.json), and leave the short Waiting.Hash, ratification commands, confirmations, issue plans and modeled views unchanged. Serve JSON containing hash, the exact sources map and derived languages only from complete factory proposal payloads whose saved hash equals Plan.Hash(), retaining detached verified payloads in a separate persistent JSON cache before publishing their URLs; GET and HEAD retain the public security policy, invalid or unknown authority and unavailable sources fail explicitly, successful URLs never change source bytes, restart revalidates cached payloads and preserves lightweight state with unavailable sources when necessary, and old snapshots containing inline acceptance bodies are discarded for refresh without mutating any proposal or marker. Both the public page and /act use a shared initially closed acceptance-source disclosure with data-plan-sources and data-source-retry hooks, loading and failure feedback, explicit retry, literal escaping and language highlighting; fetch only on opening or retry, deduplicate pending requests and reuse successful responses by full hash, retain open views across ordinary refreshes, reject missing or mismatched responses and prevent a replaced proposal from displaying an old pending response. Intentionally replace TestNativeProposalViewRetainsFullIdentityAndSource's inline-source expectation with full identities in state and exact source retrieval, add the acceptance and regression coverage for state size, byte fidelity, authority, cache damage and restart, and run go test -timeout 20m ./internal/dashboard plus go test -race -timeout 20m ./internal/dashboard, preserving the existing public, /act, ratify-all, acted and preview-cache tests. Perform and document a reproducible controlled-response browser check for both pages covering closed polls, repeated and concurrent opens, refresh retention, literal rendering, failure and retry, missing or mismatched responses and proposal replacement, and update docs/factory.md and the native-proposal and dashboard statements in SPEC.md with this delivery and cache contract, citing D-0314, D-0051, D-0060, D-0065, D-0107, D-0317, D-0105, D-0122 and D-0294 as applicable; the merger records the new source-delivery/cache decision because the build cannot write decisions/.

tests.name: Test715PolledPlansStaySmallAndKeepReviewIdentity
tests.says: Multiple large legacy and native acceptance sources do not enlarge polled state; all review metadata and the short ratification hash remain, and projection never changes the saved proposal or marker.

tests.name: Test715SourceEndpointReturnsVerbatimLegacyAndNativeFiles
tests.says: A full proposal hash retrieves exactly every legacy or native acceptance file with its language, including CRLF, literal markup and a missing final newline.

tests.name: Test715SourceEndpointAcceptsOnlyFullHashesAndReadMethods
tests.says: Known full hashes support public GET and bodyless HEAD with existing security headers; unknown hashes, shorthand, paths and issue numbers cannot select sources, and other methods are refused.

tests.name: Test715SourceAuthorityRequiresTheCompleteFactoryProposal
tests.says: Only the factory's own complete proposal with a matching full plan hash supplies sources; changed plan metadata, missing files, forged hashes and other authors cannot supply them.

tests.name: Test715SourceURLsStayIsolatedAcrossReplacementAndRestart
tests.says: Replacing a proposal gives a new full-hash URL while the earlier URL retains exactly its original source bytes, even after restart and concurrent reads.

tests.name: Test715SavedSourcesAreAvailableBeforeAnyGitHubRead
tests.says: A restarted dashboard serves the saved lightweight state and its matching verified sources before it can read GitHub, including sources never opened before the restart.

tests.name: Test715DamagedSourceCachesCannotBecomeSuccessfulReviews
tests.says: Missing, truncated and valid-JSON tampered source caches leave saved state lightweight and sources explicitly unavailable, while a later verified publication recovers the same URL.

tests.name: Test715OldInlineSnapshotsAreDiscardedBeforeServing
tests.says: An older cached snapshot carrying inline sources is discarded for refresh and never used to invent full-hash source authority from its display hash.

tests.name: Test715SourceDeliveryPreservesActAndOtherProposalViews
tests.says: Source delivery leaves modeled and issue-plan views intact, and /act still ratifies with the existing short hash and immediately republishes lightweight state without modifying proposals.

tests.name: Test715BothPagesWireTheSharedLazySourceDisclosure
tests.says: The public and authenticated pages serve the shared script with full-hash source-disclosure and retry hooks, an opening handler and escaped language highlighting, without inline-plan source rendering.

usage.summary: Wrote plan.json and ten acceptance tests covering the complete endpoint, cache, dashboard, and documentation change. Check 1 of 4 passed: all acceptance tests fail on the base as required, and repo/ remains unchanged.
